text:
elaine: alert — SCIM deprovision errors jumped to 15% at 11:10 UTC, many 403s and several service accounts left in "orphaned" state. Any recent RBAC/principal changes?
omar: pushed team-mapping rename at 10:58, swapped the role used by the provisioner: arn:aws:iam::333444555666:role/scim-provisioner-old -> arn:aws:iam::333444555666:role/scim-provisioner-rotated
raj: check provisioner logs, seeing KMS denies: 
```
2026-04-11T11:09:58Z ERROR scim-deprov decrypt failed: AccessDeniedException: User is not authorized to perform kms:Decrypt on key arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:333444555666:key/ffee-1122
```
elaine: that error pattern is KMS key policy missing the new principal. KMS returns AccessDenied with no extra detail, so deprovision items get retried and end up orphaned.
omar: I missed updating the key policy when rotating the role. Will add new ARN and keep old one for a day.
oncall-bot: incident created: INC-2026-2719 "SCIM deprov KMS AccessDenied after principal rotation" 110:12 UTC 110:22 paging eng-platform + SRE
raj: proposed policy snippet to append (simple allow):
```
{"Sid":"AllowScimProvisioner","Effect":"Allow","Principal":{"AWS":["arn:aws:iam::333444555666:role/scim-provisioner-old","arn:aws:iam::333444555666:role/scim-provisioner-rotated"]},"Action":["kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey*"],"Resource":"*"}
```
elaine: add condition:StringEquals to aws:PrincipalAccount and limit via tag if possible. After policy change, restart the provisioner pods to clear cached KMS contexts.
omar: applied policy at 11:12 and restarted scim-provisioner -> kubectl rollout restart deployment/scim-provisioner -n idp.
audit-bot: KMS key policy updated by omar at 2026-04-11T11:12:14Z (change id: kp-7788)
raj: after restart, retries succeeded; backfill finished with 0 failures for 11:00-11:12 window. Sample logs: 
```
2026-04-11T11:16:05Z INFO scim-deprov decrypt succeeded item=svcacc-77
```
elaine: follow-ups: 1) RBAC rename runbook update to include key policy step (omar). 2) CI lint to detect principal ARN mismatches vs KMS policies (eng-platform). 3) add alert for KMS AccessDenied spikes from scim-provisioner (SRE). 4) improve correlation IDs in KMS and SCIM audit logs (eng-security).
omar: opened GH-5912 with checklist and links. oncall-bot: incident INC-2026-2719 resolved — root cause: rotated principal not added to KMS key policy; remediation: updated key policy, restarted provisioner, executed backfill. Closing.
